newsitem.title: FRANCE: Retail spending weak in France in September - FCD.
newsitem.headline: Retail spending weak in France in September - FCD.

text.p: The French retail federation FCD said its FCD hypermarkets index fell 6.5 percent last month and its supermarkets index was down 4.9 percent.
The FCD said the indices had risen 5.2 percent and 4.9 percent, respectively, in August.

It said in a statement that the retreat was partly due to the fact that there was one fewer Saturday last month than in September 1995. But it added that the result underscored the weakness in spending seen in recent months.
For the first nine months of 1996, its hypermarkets index is up 1.1 percent, and the supermarkets index is up 2.2 percent.
